scripts.setup: cd apps/api && uv sync && cd ../.. && npm --prefix apps/web install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.start: npm run index && npm run dev
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app
scripts.index: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.cli index
scripts.contracts: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.export_openapi ../../contracts/openapi.json
scripts.healthcheck: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.healthcheck
scripts.lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.eval: cd apps/api && uv run python -m evals.run
